title: Matrix scalar-defect realization of a continuous Galois class
statement: Let K be a field, S its separable closure, G=Aut_K(S), and H its continuous degree-two units cohomology [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology]. For a homogeneous cycle z write c_z(g,h)=z(1,g,gh), multiplicatively. For a finite-dimensional central simple K-algebra A and x in H, define R(A,x) to mean that there exist n>0, an S-algebra splitting e:S\otimes_K A\cong M_n(S), a locally constant b:G\to GL_n(S), and a homogeneous cycle z representing x, such that for all g,h in G and a in A, g(e(1\otimes a))=b_g^{-1}e(1\otimes a)b_g and b_g g(b_h)=c_z(g,h)b_{gh}.
